Class ControllerLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ControllerLessons
public class ControllerLessons extends Object

Title: ControllerLessons Class.

Description: Handles lesson page actions by coordinating ViewLessons and ModelLessons. Validates input before saving and asks the view to display validation, selection, and database errors. Call these actions on the JavaFX Application Thread after the lesson view has been initialized.

Author:
Ahmad El-Merhaby

  • Method Details

    • lessonFromFields

      private static entityClasses.Lesson lessonFromFields(int id, int ownerId)
      Copies the form values into a separate lesson so rejected edits do not modify a lesson already held in the list. The lesson constructor trims text.
      Parameters:
      id - the selected lesson's ID, or 0 for a new lesson
      ownerId - the ID of the lesson owner
      Returns:
      a lesson containing the current form values

    • createLesson

      protected static void createLesson()
      Validates and saves a new lesson from the form, then reloads all lessons. Displays an error if validation or saving fails.

    • readLesson

      protected static void readLesson()
      Loads the selected lesson from the database into the form. Displays an error if no lesson is selected, the record no longer exists, or reading fails.

    • updateLesson

      protected static void updateLesson()
      Checks that the selected record exists and validates a separate copy of the form values before updating it. Reloads all lessons after a successful update; otherwise displays a selection, validation, or database error.

    • deleteLesson

      protected static void deleteLesson()
      Deletes the selected lesson from the database and reloads all lessons. Displays an error if no lesson is selected, the record no longer exists, or deletion fails.

    • showSelectedLessons

      protected static void showSelectedLessons()
      Replaces the displayed list with a subset of the selected lessons, then clears the selection and form. An empty selection produces an empty subset. Database records are unchanged.

    • removeFromSubset

      protected static void removeFromSubset()
      Removes the selected lesson from the displayed list, then clears the selection and form. Displays an error if no lesson is selected. The database record is unchanged; reloading all lessons restores the entry.

    • performBack

      protected static void performBack()
      Restores the scene and window title saved when the lesson page opened.

    • toggleLock

      protected static void toggleLock(ModelLessons.LessonField field)
      Toggles the selected lesson's field lock through the model and reloads the saved lesson into the form, replacing unsaved form values. Displays an error for missing selection, denied permission, a missing record, or a database failure.
      Parameters:
      field - the field whose individual lock is toggled

    • setSelectedLessonsLocked

      protected static void setSelectedLessonsLocked(boolean locked)
      Sets the whole-lesson lock for each selected lesson.
      Parameters:
      locked - true to lock; false to unlock
